blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The Governor’s Cup Under-18 Basketball Tournament is heading toward an exciting Final 4 showdown with four powerhouse teams and a collection of talented young players ready to battle for division supremacy. Mandaue City, Compostela, defending champion Talisay City and Sibonga secured the four semifinal berths after winning their respective do-or-die quarterfinal matches on Sunday, November 22, at the Pinamungajan Sports Complex in Pinamungajan, Cebu. The North Division semifinal will feature Mandaue against Compostela, while the South Division will see defending champion Talisay take on Sibonga in what promises to be an intriguing matchup.
